notes: One document, 50 units per coder, 43 matched, 7 only-A and 7 only-B, all 14 checked against the source and kept. Main disagreements: (1) phase, 9 pairs: instructor-addressed 'Require your students...' instructions coded course-start vs during-work (resolved to course-start), assessment-design advice before-course vs during-work (resolved to before-course), automated grading during-assessment, training provision before-course. (2) unit_stance: coder B marked assessment-redesign advice 'restrict' and coder A 'neutral'; resolved to neutral because the advice does not limit AI use; citation-format rules resolved to 'require'. (3) policy_type, 3 pairs: pedagogical-purpose advice P35 vs UNCOVERED (resolved UNCOVERED); 'set clear expectations' P04 vs P09 (resolved P04, no syllabus mention); 'establish clear policies' P09 vs P04 (P04). (4) actor for detector facts, all vs instructor (resolved instructor, section addressed to instructors); modality of 'must be carefully considered' (resolved must); informs vs should for the digital-literacy rationale (informs). Two A-only units that were stretched fits (P41 resilience, P60 difficulty of knowing) were set to UNCOVERED.
